## pary-p01-v01 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Power-rested unspeakable studied as the Lord's heart. Bhairava god makes gods; Bhairavī makes being and non-being. Knowledge and ignorance His-made; doctrine and opponent His-made. Six-pathed oneness where Bhairavī stands past systems' end: unsayable goal. Bliss-merged will-knowing-truing heart of gods'-god: undivided ground. Knowing-natured mirroring gains stages unattached-to-ends. Speaker-spoken-self singly of two throbs; sixfold road of sequences.

*Rasa: maṅgala-adhyayana of studied speech; vīra of thrice-made; adbhuta of foe-included; śānta of system-end goal; śānta of merged ground; vīra of gained stages; adbhuta of sixfold road — The sthāyibhāva is study-exultation: filled, unspeakable, studied. Studying relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: god-made, goddess-made. Making relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: knowing, unknowing, foe — made. Inclusion relished. The sthāyibhāva is peace: one, abided, past, goaled. Ending relished. The sthāyibhāva is peace: merged, hearted, undivided. Grounding relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: natured, mirroring, gaining. Gaining relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: spoken three, road six. Roding relished.*
